# Edible

> Edible is an AI-powered meal planning app that turns your grocery list, receipt, or a photo of your kitchen into a complete, personalized weekly meal plan with recipes, instantly.

## About

Edible helps you stop guessing what to cook. Snap a photo of your groceries or receipt, and Edible's AI generates a full weekly meal plan tailored to your dietary preferences, household size, and budget. No food goes to waste, every meal is planned, and your grocery list is built for you.
